newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran names candidates for presidential poll.
newsitem.headline: Iran names candidates for presidential poll.

text.p: Iran's Islamic watchdog group on Wednesday approved four out of 283 candidates to run in the country's presidential elections on May 23.

The Guardian Council said in a statement that after reviewing the applications in various sessions the eligibility of only four had been approved by a majority of the 12 council members, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.

The four are Majlis (parliament) speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, former intelligence minister Mohammad Mohammadi Reyshahri, former culture and Islamic guidance minister Mohammad Khatami, and Reza Zavarei, deputy head of the judiciary.
All except Zavarei are Shi'ite Moslem clerics.
Nateq-Nouri and Khatami are considered the front-runners to succeed President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
